The '''MK-X Hazard Droid''' was a type of bipedal [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced by the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. A number of MK-X Hazard Droids were deployed alongside similar models during the Colicoids' war games.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
MK-X Hazard Droids appear as enemies in the Flashpoint "Colicoid War Game" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
